import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { Before, Then, When } from '@cucumber/cucumber';

Before(function () {
  throw new Error('Missing test registry credential');
});
When('I publish an unsigned package', function () {
  this.productBoundaryReached = true;
});
Then('publishing is refused', function () {
  assert.equal(this.productBoundaryReached, true);
});
